title: 第7章 扬眉吐气的林家第8章 孤狼踪迹遭遇猎户
slug: 打猎娶妻加点我无敌了
lines: 林小满捂着脑袋，眨巴着无辜的眼睛。
“可是，可是二哥他上次就是这样的呀？抬回来的时候都要死啦。”
常氏翻了个白眼，伸手摸了摸林夜身上有血迹的地方。
发现衣服没破，也没伤口，松口气的同时，还是心疼他一身狼狈。
林夜拽着她问道：
“娘，我爹呢？”
“他去县城还没回来呢，咋了？”
一听林大河不在家，林夜眼睛在人群里扫了一圈，最后落到刚挤进来的中年男子身上。
男子和他爹差不多大，身子壮实胡子拉碴，身后还跟着三个年轻小子。
那是他家邻居王柱子和他的三个儿子。
父子四人身板结实，有一把子力气。
王柱子和林大河关系不错，两家也一直有走动。
只是原主和他的三个儿子互相看不上，并无往来。
一遇到事了，林夜首先想到的还是这家子。
他上前一步，对王柱子说道：
“王叔，我打了两头野猪，搬不回来，劳烦您帮个忙。”
他的声音不大，却像是平地一声炸雷。
周围的村民一听，顿时炸开了锅。
“野猪？还是两头？吹牛吧！”
“一个病秧子，能拉得开弓都不错了！”
“就是林大河当年也没一下打回过两头野猪……”
就连常氏也是瞪大了眼睛，嘴张着，半天合不上。
王柱子的二儿子王二铁急吼吼问道：
“林二，你真打到了野猪？莫不是诓骗我们？”
林夜表现得十分从容：“这还能有假？跟我去一看就知。”
最后还是王柱子拍板，对大儿子说道：
“大铁，去找几根棍子，再找点绳子，咱们跟着去一趟。”
林夜也将手里的竹篓递给常氏，让她带着小满回家。
不多时，五个人朝着老猫林走去。
跟着做好的标记，最终来到埋野猪的地方。
好在这段时间并没有野兽光顾。
几人一起刨开枯叶土壤，露出两只野猪的尸体。

Lin Xiaoman covered his head and blinked his innocent eyes.
"But, second brother, was he like this last time? He was going to be dead when he was brought back."
Chang rolled his eyes and reached out to touch the bloodstained area on Lin Ye's body.
I found that the clothes were not torn and there were no wounds. Although I was relieved, I still felt sorry for him and how embarrassed he was.
Lin Ye pulled her and asked:
"Mom, where is my dad?"
"He went to the county seat and hasn't come back yet. What happened?"
Upon hearing that Lin Dahe was not at home, Lin Ye scanned the crowd with his eyes, and finally landed on the middle-aged man who had just squeezed in.
The man was about the same age as his father, with a strong build and unshaven beard, and he was followed by three young men.
That was his neighbor Wang Zhuzi and his three sons.
The four of them, father and son, are strong and strong.
Wang Zhuzhu and Lin Dahe have a good relationship, and the two families have always been in contact.
It's just that the original owner and his three sons disliked each other and had no contact with each other.
When something happens, the first thing Lin Ye thinks of is this family.
He took a step forward and said to Wang Zhuzi:
"Uncle Wang, I killed two wild boars and can't move them back. Could you please help me?"
His voice was not loud, but it was like thunder on the ground.
When the surrounding villagers heard this, they immediately exploded.
"Wild boar? Or two? Brag!"
"It's great for a sick man to be able to draw a bow!"
"Even Lin Dahe didn't fight back two wild boars at once..."
Even Mr. Chang's eyes were widened and his mouth was open, unable to close it for a long time.
Wang Ertie, the second son of Wang Zhuzi, asked anxiously:
"Lin Er, did you really hit the wild boar? Are you trying to trick us?"
Lin Ye acted very calmly: "Can this be fake? Come with me and we'll find out."
In the end, Wang Zhuzi made the decision and said to his eldest son:
"Dati, go find some sticks and some ropes. Let's follow them."
Lin Ye also handed the bamboo basket in his hand to Mrs. Chang and asked her to take Xiaoman home.
Not long after, the five people walked towards the old cat forest.
Following the marked marks, we finally came to the place where the wild boar was buried.
Fortunately, no wild beasts visited during this time.
Together, several people dug away the dead leaves and soil, revealing the carcasses of two wild boars.
